_comment: ENTRY-CORE calibration (the dual-oscillator buy signal). Two staged phases: tune RSI first, then the Stochastic over the RSI survivors. Everything else inherits SFIN DefaultParams. This is the heart of the strategy — run it even if the screen says all filters are dead. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SFIN -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/sfin/reversion_cal_entry.json -out ./reports/SFIN_entry -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
